en.headline: Police seize 32 kg of ketamine worth over HK$12 million in Sha Tin public housing raid
en.dek: Officers arrested a 28-year-old man and two 15-year-old girls after finding the drugs packed with old clothes; the three are due in court on Monday.
body: The Narcotics Bureau said it seized about 32 kilograms of suspected ketamine, valued at more than HK$12 million, during an operation in a Sha Tin public housing estate on Friday afternoon.

Officers intercepted a man and a woman unpacking cardboard boxes on the street and later found a second woman inside a unit. The three, aged 15 to 28 and including two Form Four students, were arrested for trafficking in dangerous drugs. Police believe the ketamine was smuggled from overseas and concealed among old clothing.

The three remain in custody and are expected to appear at Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts on Monday. Police warned that using a public housing unit for drug trafficking can lead to immediate termination of the tenancy under the Housing Ordinance, and reiterated that trafficking carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 警方沙田公屋檢獲約32公斤氯胺酮 拘28歲男及兩名15歲少女
zh.dek: 毒品調查科周五下午行動中起出市值逾1200萬元懷疑氯胺酮，三人將於周一在屯門裁判法院提堂。
body: 警方毒品調查科表示，周五下午在沙田一個公共屋邨進行反毒品行動，檢獲約32公斤、市值超過1200萬港元的懷疑氯胺酮，並拘捕一名28歲男子及兩名15歲少女。
探員發現有人在街頭拆卸紙箱，將物品放入尼龍袋準備搬入邨內單位，隨即截查並搜查相關單位。初步調查顯示，毒品相信由海外運入，以舊衣物包裹掩飾。被捕三人年齡介乎15至28歲，報稱學生及無業。
三人現正被扣留，稍後將被暫控販運危險藥物罪名，下周一在屯門裁判法院提堂。警方重申販毒屬嚴重罪行，最高可判終身監禁，並提醒以公屋單位販毒可能被終止租約。
